home_hero_subtitle: Find the right route, vehicle and carrier for your cargo in one place.
about_hero_description: Tranzit.AZ is a cargo listing platform that accelerates connections in the freight market with a clear and convenient workflow.
about_paragraphs: Tranzit.AZ is an online cargo listing platform that simplifies communication between cargo owners, drivers and transport companies.
On the platform, cargo owners can post their listings for free, while drivers and transport companies can easily find matching loads and get in touch.
about_advantages: Save time — drivers find you, not the other way around.
Search by cargo type, vehicle and city
New order opportunities for drivers and transport companies
Direct call and communication without intermediaries
Drivers can view loads and call without registration
howitworks_description: Tranzit.AZ is not a marketplace. The platform publishes cargo listings and connects drivers directly with cargo owners.

howitworks_steps.title: Easy cargo listing
howitworks_steps.text: The cargo owner registers and fills out the cargo form in a few clicks.

howitworks_steps.title: Confirmation time
howitworks_steps.text: Your listing is reviewed within minutes and published if it complies with the rules.

howitworks_steps.title: Accessible listing page
howitworks_steps.text: Your listing appears on the main page and becomes accessible to drivers.

howitworks_steps.title: Direct call
howitworks_steps.text: Individual drivers contact you directly and agree on the details of the shipment.

footer_tagline: Public platform for cargo listings and transport connections.
